title: test(lint): compute the SYSTEM_FIELDS live census once per file, under its own hook timeout
body:
Fixes #19807

Clause-②: no

## What is red and why

The hourly full run on `main` (run 35829772446, `Test Core (2/6)` on `de4ed33f`) failed on exactly one test: `packages/lint/src/system-fields-consumers.test.ts:586` (the #8999 SYSTEM_FIELDS consumer census, 「the live population › is anchored to a real export…」) — `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms`. The shard then stopped and six scheduled packages never ran. The same failure, same shard, same test, is the only red in the last 100 hourly runs (09-21 04:01Z, 09-21 16:00Z, 09-23 07:03Z); no commit between the last green run (`fae870352`) and the red head touches `packages/lint/**`, and the file is green on PR shards, where `@objectstack/lint` runs with few neighbours.

Cause, read from the file: `liveSources()` reads every `.ts` under `packages/lint/src` (201 files) and `censusUnionConsumers` parses each with the TypeScript compiler (`setParentNodes: true`); the six live tests each recomputed that whole census under vitest's default 5,000 ms per-test wall, and the cold run crossed it on a loaded full-battery shard (13 packages, `--concurrency=4` on 4 vCPUs).

## What changed

One file, test-only: the live census is computed ONCE per file in a `beforeAll` that carries its own explicit timeout (60,000 ms, sized from the measured cold run of ~1 s on a quiet box with headroom for a contended shard), and the six live tests read that one result. `censusUnionConsumers`, `liveSources()`, the LEDGER rows, the PROVENANCE_API pin and every assertion are unchanged; no walk is narrowed, no test skipped, no file-wide or package-wide `testTimeout` raised.

## Verification

- Branch pushed by the dispatched dev (`session_01XPUwWGnmky4PXPofNsf2w7`); its report with the measured before/after durations follows on #19807.
- CI on this head is the judge: `Test Core` shards (the `@objectstack/lint` package suite), `Lint & Repo Gates`, type checks.
- Not governed (`packages/lint/src/**` is on no register surface); ordinary queue landing after the dispatching seat's ACCEPT.

Related, not changed here: #16465 / #16468 (shard-duration alarm and per-package suite-duration ratchet, `pm:queue` in `domain:devx`), and ten other test files that walk directories or parse with the TypeScript compiler under the default wall (cli ×5, spec ×4, service-analytics ×1) — none has gone red; the same one-computation shape applies if one does.
